title: 4001. Aggregate Two Time Series

examples.explanation: Timestamp series1 series2 summedValue 1 3 2 5 2 1 2 3 4 1 2 3 5 0 2 2 Thus, the aggregated series is [[1, 5], [2, 3], [4, 3], [5, 2]].
Timestamp series1 series2 summedValue 1 5 2 7 2 1 2 3 3 1 0 1 Thus, the aggregated series is [[1, 7], [2, 3], [3, 1]].

At timestamp 1, the next available value in series2 is 2 at timestamp 1000000000. At timestamp 1000000000, there is no later timestamp in series1, so its value is 0. Only timestamps that appear in at least one of the two series are included.

hints: Merge the timestamps from both series in increasing order, similarly to the merge step of merge sort.
Because a missing timestamp uses the next available value, process the merged timestamps from right to left while maintaining the next available value in each series.
At each timestamp, update the maintained value for every series containing that timestamp, then add the two maintained values to the answer.
